cohort: 428 women with class III obesity (BMI ≥ 40 kg/m²) and singleton pregnancies at or beyond 34 weeks of gestation who underwent induction of labor
finding: In women with class III obesity undergoing labor induction, the cesarean delivery rate approached 50%, with nulliparity, height, and unfavorable cervical examination identified as significant risk factors.
mod_finding: The study found a cesarean delivery rate approaching 50% in the studied cohort of women with class III obesity undergoing induction of labor.
